name: specz
description: A lightweight engineering-state and design-review protocol for capable coding models, with optional checkpoints, governed evidence, and structured human review briefs.

interface.shortDescription: Lightweight state, evidence, and design review for capable coding models.
interface.longDescription: Specz governs an engineering task from its current stage: it reconstructs goals, design, execution, approvals, and verification from task facts and durable state. It delegates design-document work to specz-brief when needed and resumes the parent task afterward. Ordinary tasks can execute directly; durable checkpoints and governed evidence are used when recovery, collaboration, approval, or audit requires them.
defaultPrompt: Use specz to decide whether this task needs durable engineering state before implementing it.
Use specz to resume the active checkpoint and execute the next ready task unit.
Use specz to delegate design-document work to specz-brief when the active task needs it, then resume the current stage.
